title: Double the duration
hook: Two stated cases: explore duration in total exposure but not an assumed memory rule.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How duration in total exposure but not an assumed memory rule affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Memory, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare duration in total exposure but not an assumed memory rule in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
